components.name: CursorLabel
components.description: A label that follows the pointer at a fixed side and gap. Scoped to its children by default; pass `global` for the whole page. Hidden on touch devices, and `aria-hidden`, so don't put anything only it can say.

props.name: content
props.description: What follows the pointer: text, any element, or a function of the pointer position. Text gets the chip style; elements render as they are.

props.name: placement
props.description: Which side of the pointer the label sits on.

props.name: offset
props.description: Gap between the pointer and the label, in px.

props.name: flip
props.description: Flip to the opposite side near an edge so the label is never cut off.

props.name: global
props.description: Follow the pointer across the whole page instead of only inside `children`.

props.name: labelClassName
props.description: Classes for the label. `className` styles the scope wrapper.
